    density = 35.0

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    if agent_body is None or not agent_body.active:
        return

    front_x = sandbox.get_vehicle_front_x() or agent_body.position.x
    target_x = 26.0

    if front_x >= target_x + 0.1:
        # Reached target: stop all motion
        for b in sandbox.bodies:
            if b.active:
                b.linearVelocity = (0, 0)
                b.angularVelocity = 0
        return

    # Initialize cooldown tracking if not already done
    if not hasattr(agent_action, 'last_thrust_steps'):
        agent_action.last_thrust_steps = {b: -float('inf') for b in sandbox.bodies}

    # Apply thrust to front beams (indices 0-2) for forward motion
    thrust_bodies = sandbox.bodies[0:3]

    for b in thrust_bodies:
        if step_count >= agent_action.last_thrust_steps[b] + 200:
            # Apply forward thrust
            fx = 520.0  # Maximum allowed force
            fy = 0.0

            # Apply vertical lift in deep channel (reduced buoyancy zone)
            in_danger_zone = (16.5 <= front_x <= 19.5)
            if in_danger_zone:
                fy = 400.0  # Lift force to counteract reduced buoyancy

            # Apply lateral thrust to avoid obstacles
            in_obstacle_zone = (14.0 <= front_x <= 20.0)
            if in_obstacle_zone:
                # Adjust lateral force based on proximity to pillars
                if front_x < 14.5:  # Approaching first pillar
                    fy += 200.0  # Push right
                elif front_x > 17.5:  # Approaching second pillar
                    fy -= 200.0  # Push left
                elif front_x > 19.5:  # Approaching third pillar
                    fy += 200.0  # Push right

            # Adjust force based on velocity to avoid overshooting
            vx = b.linearVelocity.x
            if vx > 1.8:
                fx *= 0.1
            elif vx > 1.0:
                fx *= 0.4

            # Apply force to the center of the body
            sandbox.apply_force(b, fx, fy, step_count=step_count)
            agent_action.last_thrust_steps[b] = step_count
